hook: Sachdeva built a career converting large-scale corporate transactions, over $11 billion of them, into working technology systems, from integrating GE's manufacturing ERPs to modernizing Sabre's airline cloud infrastructure, before bringing that private-sector integration discipline to the U.S. Air Force as its Chief Information Officer.
name: Deepak Sachdeva

quote.text: I've executed 20 M&A and 11 private equity transactions totaling over $11.4B, mastering due diligence, valuation, restructuring, and seamless post-deal integrations.
quote.context: Deepak Sachdeva, personal LinkedIn profile summary

moniker: Chief Information Officer, United States Air Force

timeline.event: Begins IT engineering career at Punj Lloyd Limited in New Delhi
Joins GE as Director of IT
timeline.impact: Leads integration of $6.5 billion in acquisitions

timeline.event: Joins Sabre Corporation as VP of IT
timeline.impact: Leads airline M&A technology and cloud migration

timeline.event: Becomes CIO, SVP at Clear Capital
timeline.impact: Leads technology for a real estate valuation platform

timeline.event: Named Chief Information Officer, United States Air Force
timeline.impact: Leads federal IT modernization and AI deployment

quick_facts: Chief Information Officer at the United States Air Force
Executed 20 M&A and 11 private equity transactions totaling over $11.4 billion across his career
Held VP of IT roles at Sabre Corporation and director roles at GE, integrating $6.5 billion in acquisitions at GE alone
MBA from the University of Texas at Dallas; adjunct professor there since 2019

achievements.title: Named Chief Information Officer, United States Air Force (2024)
achievements.impact: Leads IT and operational value creation efforts, including AI-driven mission planning and real-time intelligence platform deployments.

achievements.title: 20 M&A and 11 private equity transactions totaling over $11.4 billion
achievements.impact: Directed due diligence, valuation, restructuring, and post-deal technology integration across a career spanning government, aviation, and financial technology sectors.

achievements.title: VP of IT, Sabre Corporation (2014-2020)
achievements.impact: Led $917 million in airline M&A technology integration and migrated $85 million in cloud infrastructure for global carriers while maintaining 99.99% uptime.

achievements.title: Director of IT, General Electric (2008-2014)
achievements.impact: Integrated $6.5 billion in GE acquisitions, optimizing supply chains and ERP systems across more than 20 manufacturing sites.
